record.one_liner: SE Ranking: SEO data platform (keywords, rank tracking, backlinks, site audits, domain research) with a REST Data API and an official MCP server.
record.auth_notes: API key from the account's API section, sent as 'Authorization: Token <key>' (recommended) or as an apikey query parameter. Both are static keys, so both map to api_key.
record.access_notes: API access comes with any paid plan (Core and Growth) and can be tested in the free trial account. Pay-as-you-go needs a $50 minimum deposit and an API add-on starts at $149/month. No permanent free tier was seen on the pages read.
record.api_notes: REST endpoints under api.seranking.com/v1 with GET and POST, including backlinks, keyword research, website audit and project management. Breadth judged moderate from the product pages read; the full endpoint list was not enumerated.
record.blocker_notes: Trial credentials are self-serve and the documented API is public. Ongoing production use needs a paid plan or API add-on after the trial.
